tasks.answer: Use DeleteDiscussion, the destructive confirmation control for deleting a discussion; pass the discussion id.
Input (text input with FieldWrapper label/error). Bind react-hook-form by passing the field's register(...) result as the required registration prop, inside a Form.
TablePagination builds links as rootUrl?page=N; it requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl (rootUrl must not already contain a query string).
MDPreview renders sanitized Markdown as HTML; it receives the Markdown source via the value prop.
CreateDiscussion is an admin-only drawer form for creating a discussion; it requires admin permission.

notes: One search per task (5 total) plus one combined get for Input and TablePagination. No repeated IDs, no --include props, no source reads; budget held.
